level_one.title: Mana Addict
level_one.description: Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Kael'thas's maximum Mana by 15.  Reward: After gathering 20 Globes, Kael'thas can activate Arcane Barrier to gain a Shield equal to 100% of his maximum Mana for 4 seconds. 45 second cooldown.

level_four.title: Nether Wind
level_four.description: Increases Gravity Lapse's range by 30%. When Gravity Lapse hits an enemy Hero, refund 80 Mana.

level_seven.title: Burned Flesh
level_seven.description: When Flamestrike damages 2 or more Heroes, they take additional damage equal to 8% of their maximum Health.

level_ten.title: Pyroblast
level_ten.description: After 1.5 seconds, cast a slow-moving fireball that deals 810 (+5% per level) damage to an enemy Hero and 405 (+5% per level) damage to enemies nearby.

level_thirteen.title: Pyromaniac
level_thirteen.description: Each time Living Bomb deals periodic damage, Kael'thas's Basic Ability cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Fury of the Sunwell
level_sixteen.description: Flamestrike will explode a second time 1.5 seconds later.

level_twenty.title: Flamethrower
level_twenty.description: Increases the cast range of Flamestrike by 40%. If Flamestrike hits 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Adrenaline Stimpack
level_one.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 20% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.  Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

level_four.title: Incinerator Gauntlets
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 40%.

level_seven.title: Nanomachine Coating
level_seven.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spills and Ignited Oil Spills have their Attack Speed reduced by 35% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Bunker Drop
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

level_thirteen.title: Collision Course
level_thirteen.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 260 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Juggernaut Plating
level_sixteen.description: Activate to gain 50 Spell Armor for 3 seconds. Upon expiration, gain a Shield equal to 125% of the Spell Damage taken while Juggernaut Plating was active.

level_twenty.title: Fortified Bunker
level_twenty.description: Occupants can cast Oil Spill from Bunker Drop every 6 seconds. Additionally, Bunker Drop's Armor bonus upon exiting is increased by 25, and its duration by 1 second.

level_one.title: Nerubian Armor
level_one.description: Increase Harden Carapace's Spell Armor by 25.

level_four.title: Underking
level_four.description: Increases Burrow Charge range by 20% and damage by 100%.

level_seven.title: Chitinous Plating
level_seven.description: While Harden Carapace is active, taking damage from enemy Abilities reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Cocoon
level_ten.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

level_thirteen.title: Urticating Spines
level_thirteen.description: Casting Harden Carapace will also deal 90 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies. Deals double damage against Heroes.

level_sixteen.title: Epicenter
level_sixteen.description: Increases Burrow Charge impact area by 60% and lowers the cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

level_twenty.title: Rewind
level_twenty.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.

level_one.title: Evenhanded Blessings
level_one.description: If Flash Heal is cast on a different target from its last, increase its healing by 15% and refund 40% of its cooldown.

level_four.title: Piercing Light
level_four.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.  Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

level_seven.title: Binding Heal
level_seven.description: Casting Flash Heal on an ally heals Anduin for 135 (+4% per level).

level_ten.title: Lightbomb
level_ten.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Enchant Boots - Lion's Speed
level_thirteen.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. This bonus is quadrupled while Leap of Faith's cooldown is available. Allies pulled by Leap of Faith are healed for 280 (+4% per level) over 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Glyph of Faith
level_sixteen.description: Leap of Faith gains a 2nd charge.

level_twenty.title: Censure
level_twenty.description: Chastise Stuns for 0.75 seconds and its Root duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

level_one.title: Perfect Aim
level_one.description: Increases Gilnean Cocktail's range by 30% and refunds 45 Mana if it hits an enemy Hero.

level_seven.title: Incendiary Elixir
level_seven.description: Quest: Reduce the cooldown of Gilnean Cocktail by 2 seconds. Every time Greymane hits an enemy Hero with the explosion damage from Gilnean Cocktail, increase its explosion damage by 25, up to 375.  Reward: After hitting 15 Heroes, the cooldown is reduced by an additional 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Cursed Bullet
level_ten.description: Greymane shapeshifts into a Human and fires a bullet that hits the first enemy Hero in its path, dealing 35% of their current Health in damage.  Does not affect Vehicles.

level_thirteen.title: Running Wild
level_thirteen.description: Increases Darkflight and Disengage's range by 35%, and reduce their cooldowns by 1 second.

level_sixteen.title: Lord of His Pack
level_sixteen.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases Greymane's Basic Attack damage by 25% for 3 seconds, increased to 50% while in Worgen Form.

level_twenty.title: Gilnean Roulette
level_twenty.description: Cursed Bullet's damage is reduced to 30% of current health but its cooldown is reduced by 24 seconds.

level_one.title: Maximum Effort
level_one.description: If Carnage damages the same enemy Hero 3 times it deals an additional 108 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 25% for 2.5 seconds.

level_four.title: Upstage
level_four.description: Damaging at least 2 Heroes with Blood Rage causes Qhira to Evade the next 4 Heroic Basic Attacks within 12 seconds.

level_seven.title: The Thirst
level_seven.description: Carnage heals for 50% of the damage dealt to enemy Heroes. Anytime Carnage damages an enemy Hero, Qhira's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds against an enemy Hero deals 15% additional damage, stacking up to 10 times.

level_ten.title: Unrelenting Strikes
level_ten.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Chainsaw
level_thirteen.description: Carnage's cooldown recharges 100% faster while an enemy Hero has maximum Blood Rage stacks.

level_sixteen.title: Booming Kick
level_sixteen.description: Increase the Stun duration of Revolving Sweep's re-activation by 0.25 seconds. Enemy Heroes around the primary target are also affected by Revolving Sweep's re-activation.

level_one.title: Recklessness
level_one.description: While Zul'jin is below 75% Health, he gains 10% Spell Power. While he is below 50% Health, his Basic Attack damage is increased by 10% and Basic Attacks against Heroes grant an additional stack of You Want Axe?.

level_four.title: Amani Hide
level_four.description: Lower the cooldown of Amani Rage by 10 seconds and gain 15 Armor while regenerating Health from it.

level_seven.title: Arcanite Axes
level_seven.description: Quest: Twin Cleave's damage is permanently increased by 0.75 every time it hits a Hero.

level_ten.title: Taz'dingo!
level_ten.description: For the next 4 seconds, Zul'jin is Unkillable, and cannot be reduced to less than 1 Health. Taz'dingo!

level_thirteen.title: Lacerate
level_thirteen.description: Increase the Slow amount of each Twin Cleave axe by 10% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Let the Killing Begin
level_sixteen.description: When Zul'jin kills an enemy, his Attack Speed is increased by 5%, up to 40%, for 12 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration.  Hero Takedowns instantly grant 40% Attack Speed.

level_one.title: Ranger
level_one.description: Sentinel width is increased by 25% and deals up to 250% more damage based on distance traveled.

level_four.title: Everlasting Light
level_four.description: If Light of Elune's second charge is cast on a different target from the first, it heals for 80% more.

level_seven.title: Kaldorei Resistance
level_seven.description: Light of Elune grants the target 10 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

level_ten.title: Starfall
level_ten.description: Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Harsh Moonlight
level_thirteen.description: Sentinel Slows enemies hit by 35% and reduces their damage dealt by 35% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Celestial Attunement
level_sixteen.description: Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.

level_one.title: Enhanced Agility
level_one.description: Brushstalker's Movement Speed bonus now lasts for 4 seconds after leaving a bush.  Repeatable Quest: Every 50 Essence collected permanently increases the Movement Speed bonus of Brushstalker by 2%, up to 20%.

level_four.title: One-Who-Collects
level_four.description: Increases Essence collected from Minions by 50%. Dark Swarm deals 40% more damage to Mercenaries.

level_seven.title: Paralyzing Enzymes
level_seven.description: Drag Slows the target by 40% and reduces their healing received by 50% while active and for 2 seconds after ending. Dehaka's Basic Attacks increase the duration of the healing reduction to 2 seconds.

level_ten.title: Isolation
level_ten.description: Launch biomass that hits the first enemy Hero dealing 200 (+4% per level) damage, revealing, Silencing, and Slowing them 30% for 3 seconds. Additionally, their vision radius is greatly reduced for 6 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Primal Swarm
level_thirteen.description: Dark Swarm causes enemies hit to lose 10 Armor for 0.75 seconds, causing them to take 10% extra damage.

level_sixteen.title: Pack Leader
level_sixteen.description: Dehaka gains 40 Armor and 15% increased Attack Speed while in a bush and for 4 seconds after leaving.

level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Hold Your Ground
level_four.description: Increases Iron Skin's Shield by 40% and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Blessed Shield
level_ten.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Roar
level_thirteen.description: Increase Punish's damage by 50%. This bonus is increased to 150% whenever Punish hits 2 or more Heroes.

level_sixteen.title: Holy Renewal
level_sixteen.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1 second and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.
